text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Seriously, just grabbing boba together 
would be amazing! —We just admire you so 
much, City...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I think the agency has 
mentioned this a few times, but things 
like this are..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waitin', City! Turns out 
I really did leave my phone in the 
storeâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Wait, huh? Doing some fan service??

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Are you a friend of City-san's?! —Um, can 
we join you guys too?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaah! Understood completely☆ Alright, 
alright! In that case..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...! Helios-san, I can't let myself bother 
you on your day off—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Only if you can catch up to us, that is! ☆

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's go, City! Explosive front-running~~☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're catching up, they're 
catching up! City fans got crazy love! 
Celebrity power is unreal!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...! Even though I was the one 
who asked you to come hang out and 
relax...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up. Leave the 
front-running to me☆ More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fans
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on! You gotta go with a whoosh! At 
times like this, it's like~~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yoicho~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh!? After front-running that much, she 
can still accelerate like that!? —I'm 
gonna lose sight of her~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (!! When did this even happen...?!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... ...Looks like everything is all 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Helios. And also...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I was blown away! It's even more polished 
than before. No wonder you said "leave it 
to me"—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was su~per freaked out too! It 
zapped right into my head, and I totally 
blew it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, wasn't this all thanks to me and 
City going all-out on the breakaway? Which 
meaaans...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's not a bother at all, right?! In fact, 
drag me right into it~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Like I'd ever let it be a bother, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Haha! ......Understood!

From this day on, Daitaku Helios's running 
became all the more sharp!
